# L4.6b — Replay of effect-dispatching runs: the shared-id ceremony/divergence contract (ADR-0381 leg (a))

Ticket: `docs/tickets/164x_L4.6b__replay-effect-runs-contract.md` · seq 164x · base `svitali/harnessharness-l4.6` · stacked on the L4.6 PR. Run-time insert under the operator's ruling on L4.6's surfaced blocker ("I approve inserting the proposed ticket to fix the replay-of-effect-runs contract", received 2026-10-23 — GATE DECISIONS row).

**Requirement ids:** L4.6's surfaced blocker (deterministic replay of an effect-dispatching live run answered `invalid{replay_diverged}` 3/3 on the anthropic lane) · `R-2.11.1`, `R-2.11.2`, `R-2.11.3` (replay byte-identity on the shipped `hh`/`hh-web`/`hh-mcp` surfaces) · the round-4 charter "deep end to end live verification".

## The defect and the fix

**Defect (L4.6 capstone §SURFACED BLOCKER):** `mc-N`/`tc-N`/`ef-N`/`d-N`/`e-N`
share one monotone allocator (`hh-control` Driver `next_id`). The live drive
mints the dispatch ceremony — `security.permission.decided`,
`action.effect.authorized`, `action.effect.prepared`,
`action.effect.committed` — that `ReplayGate` served with `emitted: vec![]`,
so the re-drive's next model call allocated ~4 ids earlier than the record
holds and the port honestly reported `replay_diverged`.

**ADR-0381 leg (a) — the re-drive re-mints the recorded ceremony.** `extract_recorded`
reclassifies the recorded gate `emitted` rows inside each driver-minted
`action.effect.intended`…terminal window into `RecordedInputs.effect_lifecycle`
(re-serve feed, by effect_id) + the `driver_seqs` lattice; `ReplayGate::dispatch`
re-serves them verbatim via `GateOutcome.emitted`, so `append_producer` mints
the same `e-N` ids and the shared allocator stays in step.
`EffectGate::producer_component` widened `&'static str` → `&str` so re-minted
rows carry the *recorded* producer ref (INV-7 honesty). `decider:human`
permission rows stay external cues; service-minted terminals
(`report_host_effect` settling `Pending`) stay external and the replayed gate
serves `Pending` exactly as live — a driver re-mint there would spend a
`next_id` live never allocated.

Leg (b) — recorded-terminal ports matching positionally/by-content —
named-rejected in ADR-0381: it needs allocator-id normalization inside compared
payloads, weakening byte-identity and masking id-sequence tampering. Spec §05a
R-2.2.4 pins the contract (reproduce decision/assembled sequences; dispatch
**no** effect; honest `ReplayDiverged`), not the mechanism → the ADR records
the silence; no spec text moved (deliverable 4 verified by grep).
